queries.name: classification_integrity
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) row_count,COUNT(DISTINCT "ItemCode") unique_codes,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE valid_from IS NOT NULL OR valid_to IS NOT NULL) dated_rows FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet')

queries.name: invoice_headers
queries.sql:
SELECT canceled,currency,COUNT(*) documents,COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) unique_documents,
MIN(doc_date) first_date,MAX(doc_date) last_date,MIN(source_as_of) source_as_of_min,MAX(source_as_of) source_as_of_max,
SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) doc_total,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) IS NULL) invalid_amounts
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV' AND doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: invoice_join_integrity
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) joined_lines,
COUNT(DISTINCT l.doc_entry || ':' || l.line_num) unique_lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.raw_extraction_id IS DISTINCT FROM l.raw_extraction_id) extraction_mismatches,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.source_as_of IS DISTINCT FROM l.source_as_of) as_of_mismatches,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.currency IS DISTINCT FROM l.currency) currency_mismatches,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) IS NULL) invalid_amounts
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV' AND doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01') d JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1') l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE d.canceled='N'

queries.name: invoice_reconciliation
queries.sql:
WITH totals AS (
SELECT d.doc_entry,d.currency,CAST(d.doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) header_amount,
COUNT(l.line_num) lines,COUNT(DISTINCT x.product_business_type) categories,
COALESCE(SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),0) line_amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV' AND doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01') d LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1') l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
WHERE d.canceled='N' GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT currency,COUNT(*) documents,SUM(lines) lines,SUM(header_amount) header_amount,SUM(line_amount) line_amount,
SUM(header_amount-line_amount) residual,SUM(ABS(header_amount-line_amount)) absolute_residual,
MAX(ABS(header_amount-line_amount)) max_absolute_residual,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ABS(header_amount-line_amount)<=0.01) reconciled_within_cent,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ABS(header_amount-line_amount)>0.01) unexplained_documents,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE lines=0) documents_without_lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE categories>1) multicategory_documents
FROM totals GROUP BY 1

queries.name: invoice_category_observations
queries.sql:
SELECT d.currency header_currency,l.currency line_currency,
x.product_business_type,x.status,x.classification_basis,
COUNT(*) lines,COUNT(DISTINCT l.item_code) products,COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) documents,
SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) recorded_line_total,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE x."ItemCode" IS NULL) unclassified_lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE l.item_code IS NULL OR l.item_code='') no_item_code
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV' AND doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01') d JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1') l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
WHERE d.canceled='N' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

queries.name: credit_base_links
queries.sql:
SELECT l.base_type,COUNT(*) lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.doc_entry IS NOT NULL) linked_invoice_lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.item_code IS DISTINCT FROM l.item_code) product_mismatches,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.canceled IS DISTINCT FROM 'N') base_not_active_or_missing,
MIN(h.doc_date) earliest_base_date,MAX(h.doc_date) latest_base_date,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))<0) negative_line_amounts
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='ORIN' AND doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01') d JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='RIN1') l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) i ON l.base_type='13' AND i.source_system=l.source_system AND i.source_table='INV1'
 AND i.doc_entry=l.base_entry AND i.line_num=l.base_line
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) h ON h.source_system=i.source_system AND h.source_table='OINV' AND h.doc_entry=i.doc_entry
WHERE d.canceled='N' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
